outcome: Pain perception during the immediate postpartum period
cohort: 150 women in the immediate postpartum period
finding: Difficulties in emotion regulation, measured by the Difficulties in Emotion Regulation Scale (DERS), are associated with higher pain perception, measured by the Visual Analog Scale (VAS), in the immediate postpartum period, regardless of mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Higher DERS scores were associated with higher pain scores regardless of mode of delivery.
